question: Should OpenClaw add HEARTBEAT.md task-level model metadata, split or group due heartbeat tasks by model, or keep heartbeat routing at the current whole-turn/plugin/cron level?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but implementation depends on maintainer intent for public HEARTBEAT.md syntax, model alias/fallback/auth semantics, and whether one heartbeat tick may become multiple model turns.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a reusable heartbeat task routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only task metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow HEARTBEAT.md model field with explicit split/group behavior, fallback rules, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep whole-turn alternatives only
options.body: Document before_model_resolve plugins and cron jobs as the supported routing paths and accept that batched heartbeat tasks cannot be independently routed today.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a reusable heartbeat task routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on the model-routing hook seam and the product-boundary decision this feature needs.
